about: Official pages the watch skill checks for exam dates, registration windows and course intakes (docs/SPEC.md §4.5, §6). Phase 5 moves the exam entries into the blueprints exams/<id>.json; the course entry stays here.

sources.what: Ελληνομάθεια B1 (Centre for the Greek Language)
sources.look_for: The next May and October exam dates for B1, and the registration window (opens / closes). The May session is for all levels; the October session is B1 and in Greece only.

sources.what: A2 + history exam for long-term residence (Ministry of Education)
sources.what_tr: Uzun süreli oturum için A2 + tarih sınavı (Eğitim Bakanlığı)
sources.look_for: A new call (προκήρυξη) for the next session: exam date, application window, fee and number of places. Sessions are announced late and places are capped, so any new call is news.

sources.what: University of Athens Modern Greek courses (an evening course after 17:00)
sources.what_tr: Atina Üniversitesi Modern Yunanca kursları (17:00'den sonra bir akşam kursu)
sources.look_for: Any course whose classes start after 17:00 (the learner's condition), with its start date and registration deadline. Courses that do not fit the hours are not news; mention them only if nothing fits for a long time.
